profile.label: Maya · kidney + genetics
profile.goal: Protect kidney health and avoid injections
profile.notes: Synthetic case. CKD diagnosis previously confirmed.

risks.title: Review renal suitability of metformin
risks.detail: Reduced kidney function requires current label, dose and trend review. The prototype does not calculate a dose.

risks.title: Gene–drug safety signal
risks.detail: Verified SLCO1B1 poor function plus simvastatin warrants pharmacist/prescriber review for an alternative. Ask about muscle pain, weakness or dark urine.

options.title: Review the metformin + SGLT2 pathway
options.detail: Discuss suitability, current therapy, renal labels and contraindications. This is a class-level option for clinician review, not an instruction to start a drug.
options.why: eGFR 42; confirmed CKD makes kidney protection relevant.

options.title: Agree a feasible nutrition and movement plan
options.detail: Build around Vegetarian meals; sedentary desk work. Choose one achievable food change and activity goal with the care team; adapt activity for symptoms, falls risk and comorbidities.
options.why: Patient priority: Protect kidney health and avoid injections.

options.title: Check affordability before choosing an agent
options.detail: Review formulary coverage, generic options and out-of-pocket cost with a pharmacist; ask which treatments are realistically sustainable.
options.why: Limited budget is recorded. Actual costs and insurance coverage are unknown.

monitoring.task: Reconcile medicines and allergies; verify renal trend, urine ACR, blood pressure, relevant contraindications, access and shared HbA1c goal.
Clinician sets timing for renal function, volume status and blood pressure review based on the selected medicine and baseline risk.
Review HbA1c until stable, treatment tolerance and the patient’s goal; agree whether the plan should change.
Provide written sick-day and surgery/fasting advice; discuss ketosis symptoms and when to seek urgent care. Follow the local medicine label.

trace.title: Check scope and urgency
trace.detail: Adult type 2 diabetes; no urgent symptom flag in the supplied profile.

trace.title: Connect patient factors
trace.detail: eGFR 42; HbA1c 8.4%; confirmed CKD; genetics poor; budget limited.

trace.title: Retrieve and constrain
trace.detail: MiniLM sentence embeddings and cosine retrieval rank source-aware chunks. Rule-linked sources are retained. Similarity is not clinical confidence.

trace.title: Require human review
trace.detail: No doses, prescriptions or automatic approval. Sources and missing information remain visible.

evidence.title: Diabetes with chronic kidney disease
evidence.tags: diabetes kidney renal egfr ckd albuminuria metformin sglt2 dpp4
evidence.summary: Kidney function changes the diabetes pathway. At eGFR ≥30, metformin and SGLT-2 options feature; at 20–29, selected SGLT-2 and DPP-4 options feature; below 20 a DPP-4 option may be considered.
evidence.scope: UK pathway; drug-specific renal labels still apply.
evidence.license_note: Original short paraphrase; source rights apply.

evidence.title: Initial medicines for type 2 diabetes
evidence.tags: diabetes metformin sglt2 heart failure cardiovascular obesity initial medicine glucose
evidence.summary: The adult type 2 diabetes pathways use metformin and SGLT-2 options, with comorbidity-specific selection and suitability checks.
evidence.scope: Class-level discussion only; verify current local label and availability.
evidence.license_note: Original short paraphrase; source rights apply.

evidence.title: SLCO1B1 and statin-associated muscle symptoms
evidence.tags: genetics slco1b1 simvastatin statin poor decreased function myopathy muscle risk
evidence.summary: Reduced SLCO1B1 function raises simvastatin muscle-toxicity risk. CPIC recommends alternative statin selection for poor function; use the verified phenotype and full medication context.
evidence.scope: Applies to an existing validated genetic result; does not justify routine testing or infer ancestry.
evidence.license_note: Original short paraphrase; source rights apply.

evidence.title: CKD evaluation and management
evidence.tags: kidney ckd egfr albuminuria sglt2 fasting surgery ketosis renal monitoring
evidence.summary: SGLT2 therapy in eligible CKD needs renal and volume assessment. Withholding during prolonged fasting, surgery or critical illness may reduce ketosis risk.
evidence.scope: Eligibility, current product label and clinical supervision must be checked.
evidence.license_note: Original short paraphrase; source rights apply.

evidence.title: Individualised care and shared decisions
evidence.tags: diabetes lifestyle diet exercise goals preferences cost frailty hypoglycaemia monitoring hba1c
evidence.summary: Agree goals around comorbidities, preferences and daily life. Review HbA1c every 3–6 months until stable, then every 6 months. Adapt dietary advice to the individual.
evidence.scope: UK guideline; local clinical judgement required.
evidence.license_note: Original short paraphrase; source rights apply.

Medication doses, adherence and complete interaction review
Blood pressure, cardiovascular history and adverse reactions
Shared HbA1c target, local formulary and verified genetic report
limitations: Research prototype; not clinically validated or a substitute for a licensed clinician.
Bounded adult type 2 diabetes pathway. Interaction and allergy screening are incomplete.
UK NICE pathways and international KDIGO/CPIC evidence; local licensing and practice may differ.
